reviews.title: The best way to play Subway Surfers
reviews.text: Subway Surfers is still incredibly fun after all these years, and the Apple Arcade version makes it even better. No ads or in-app purchases means I can just enjoy the game without interruptions. The gameplay is smooth, the World Tour locations keep things fresh, and it’s perfect for playing for a few minutes whenever I have some free time. This is exactly what an Arcade version of a classic mobile game should be.
